mapper.select: SELECT p.permission_code,r.data_scope FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status=1 AND r.deleted=0 AND p.status=1 AND p.permission_type=3

SELECT u.id,u.employee_no,u.real_name,u.dept_id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id=u.dept_id WHERE u.status=1 AND u.employment_status=1 AND u.deleted=0 AND d.status=1 AND d.deleted=0 AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.permission_code) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND r.status=1 AND r.deleted=0 AND p.status=1 AND p.permission_code IN('clue:convert','customer:list'))=2 ORDER BY u.id
mapper.sql: SELECT l.*,o.real_name AS owner_name,o.dept_id AS owner_dept_id,a.real_name AS creator_name,a.dept_id AS creator_dept_id, d.dept_name AS target_dept_name,cx.id AS converted_customer_id FROM crm_lead l LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=l.owner_id JOIN sys_user a ON a.id=l.created_by JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id=l.target_dept_id LEFT JOIN crm_customer cx ON cx.source_lead_id=l.id
mapper.select: WHERE l.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_lead l LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=l.owner_id JOIN sys_user a ON a.id=l.created_by
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id,c.owner_id,c.pool_dept_id,c.created_by,c.source_lead_id,c.company_name,c.customer_type,c.region,c.source,c.address,c.remark,c.relationship,c.protected_customer,c.last_follow_at,c.next_follow_at,c.created_at,c.updated_at,COALESCE(pc.contact_name,'') AS contact_name,COALESCE(pc.phone,'') AS phone,COALESCE(pc.email,'') AS email,o.real_name AS owner_name,o.dept_id AS owner_dept_id,a.real_name AS creator_name,d.dept_name AS pool_dept_name,sc.real_name AS source_creator_name, pr.id AS pending_request_id,pr.reason AS pool_request_reason, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_opportunity b WHERE b.customer_id=c.id AND b.stage NOT IN('WON','LOST')) AS active_opportunities FROM crm_customer c LEFT JOIN crm_contact pc ON pc.customer_id=c.id AND pc.is_primary=1 AND pc.status=1 LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id JOIN sys_user a ON a.id=c.created_by JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id=c.pool_dept_id LEFT JOIN crm_pool_request pr ON pr.customer_id=c.id AND pr.status='PENDING' LEFT JOIN crm_lead sl ON sl.id=c.source_lead_id LEFT JOIN sys_user sc ON sc.id=sl.created_by

WHERE 1=1
AND c.owner_id IS NULL AND (c.pool_dept_id=#{scope.userDeptId} OR c.pool_dept_id IN #{d})
AND c.owner_id IS NOT NULL
AND (c.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR pc.contact_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: WHERE c.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
WHERE c.company_name=#{name}
